title: Quantifying and Mitigating Selection Bias in LLMs: A Transferable LoRA Fine-Tuning and Efficient Majority Voting Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring inconsistencies and variance in model predictions and confidence scores across different permutations (orderings) of multiple-choice options using the Permutation Bias Metric (PBM), Fluctuation Rate (FR), Standard Deviation of Recalls (RStd), and Choice Kullback-Leibler Divergence (CKLD).
